help.about: A library for the prompts you write for music, picture and chat tools: titles, tags, every version, and what each one made.

manifest.summary: A library of prompts. Each prompt is for one target from targets.json (Suno style and lyrics, AI Studio prompt and negative, a system prompt and prompt for Claude or Jan) with that target's boxes. Every save that changes the text is a new version, kept with a note; the history shows each version's line diff and can load an old one back. {{name}} in the text gets a box to fill in, and Copy copies the text with the values put in. Results (what came out, a 0 to 5 rating, a link or file path) are kept against a version. Search covers titles, tags and the newest text; archive hides without deleting; Export all downloads everything as JSON.
